204.description: Reset email sent if account exists

400.description: Token invalid or expired, or password too short

parameters.name: rows
parameters.description: Number of data rows to return. Clamped to 10–50. Default: 20.

parameters.name: sheet
parameters.description: Sheet name for XLS/XLSX files. Defaults to the first sheet.

CanonicalColumn.description: A canonical column the system understands. Extend as needed.

ColumnMapping.description: A user's markup of an uploaded file.

oneOf.description: Multiply numeric value by a constant.

ColumnTransform.description: Transforms applied per-column while reading a source file.

ColumnType.description: Expected data type for an output column.

filename.description: Base filename (without extension) for the output file.

steps.description: Processing steps applied in order (filters and transforms).

DatetimeFormat.description: How a datetime column value should be interpreted.

ExprTransform.description:
A column transform using the expression engine.
Sets `field` = `eval(expr, current_row)` for each row.

expr.description: Expression whose result is assigned to `field`.

field.description: Target field name in the canonical row.

headers.description: Column headers from the first row, in source order.

rows.description: Data rows (each row is an array of cell values).

sheet_names.description: Sheet names — populated for XLS/XLSX files, empty for CSV.

InputSpec.description: Per-file input specification supplied inline when starting a merge run.

columns.description: Column mappings: source index → canonical name + per-column transforms.

file_id.description: ID of an uploaded file to merge.

header_row.description: 1-based row that contains column headers. Default: 1.

sheet_name.description: Sheet name for XLS/XLSX files. Defaults to the first sheet.

MappedColumn.description: One column inside a `ColumnMapping.columns` JSON array.

canonical.description:
Canonical name; if None, the column is read but not used in the output
unless an `extra` output column references it by header.

source_header.description: Header text as seen in the file (informational).

OutputColumn.description: One column in a user-defined output format.

canonical.description: If set, this column is sourced from the canonical schema.

col_type.description: Expected data type for this column.

default_value.description: Value used when the source field is absent.

name.description: Header text written in the output file.

steps.description: Processing steps applied in order (filters and transforms).

oneOf.description:
Batch of filters. Drops rows where any item evaluates to false/null
(within the matching scope).
Batch of transforms. Each item sets `field` = eval(expr, row).

OutputStep.description:
One processing step. Steps are applied in order; items within a step
also apply in order. A step is homogeneous — either all filters or all
transforms.

inputs.description: One entry per input file. At least one required.

output_format_id.description: Output format that defines the column schema and global transforms.

headers.description: Column headers parsed from the first row of the file, in source order.
